excerpt: Your dot is an always-on agent that keeps work moving across your tools and projects. You can keep talking to it while it works, and it reaches out with results or decisions that need you.
your dot lives in the cloud and has its own computer and browser. You can reach it and it can keep working even when your computer is off.
Give your dot a name and choose its shape, color, eyes, glasses, and accessories. You can change these anytime.
In ChatGPT, select the phone button in your dot's conversation to start a call. You can also type messages while you're talking.
You reach the same dot in ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, or a call. Changing where you talk to it doesn't start a new dot or reset its memory.
ask it to keep routine progress in ChatGPT and bring decisions to you in Slack.
In Slack, you can send a direct message or add your dot to a channel and mention it in a thread.
It can use background agents to work on several things in parallel while you keep talking to it.
open its computer and select Take over. Select Return control when you're ready for your dot to continue.
Connect your computer once through your dot's profile to make its local files, code, and apps available for your dot's work.
connect Gmail to find relevant email, Google Drive to read and update documents, or GitHub to investigate an issue and prepare a pull request.
Connect apps such as email, calendar, and files, or skip this step and add them later.
Your dot can delegate parts of a request to ChatGPT Work or Codex. In the desktop app, open your dot's profile and select Activity to inspect delegated work
Check the connected planning channel each weekday at 9 AM Central for the next four weeks. Update my checklist when a deadline changes.
ask it to investigate new bug reports in a connected Slack channel and prepare fixes for your review.
When a website needs a login, your dot can send a request with a private form. Enter your credentials there
When offered, Save to Passwords lets you save a login for future sign-ins. Saving is optional.
Create a task in a Codex cloud environment you have already set up. Your computer can be offline.
Your dot can create local Work or Codex tasks and continue existing local Codex tasks.
Select Add, describe the action, choose how your dot should handle it, and select Add rule.
Your existing ChatGPT app permissions apply to your dot. For example, you can allow it to read email without allowing it to send email.
Pause stops your dot's current main task. It doesn't stop every delegated task or cancel future scheduled runs.
It also keeps its own notes about preferences, decisions, and ongoing work so it can use them in later conversations.
your dot might flag that a release decision conflicts with a draft you shared last week.
Investigate bugs, implement changes, and run builds using permitted local repositories, developer tools, and skills.
After setup, you can open the same dot in the ChatGPT mobile app when the supporting update is available.
